description: bob-specific exceptions to the shared tpsdev-ai preset. bob's bunfig.toml refuses any version younger than 7 days at install time, so advisory fixes wait the same 7 days here (an urgent fresh fix is a deliberate PR that adds the package to bunfig's minimumReleaseAgeExcludes). Lockfile maintenance is off: a lockfile refresh would move the pi runtime's transitive packages, which change only in a deliberate pi upgrade.

packageRules.description: bob pins the pi runtime at exactly 0.84.3 on purpose: bob builds on its ModelRuntime seam, and a pi upgrade is a deliberate, spec'd PR with its own review, never a Renovate bump. The rule covers the whole @earendil-works family (pi-coding-agent and pi-ai directly; pi-agent-core, pi-client, pi-protocol, pi-telemetry and pi-tui through the lockfile).

CodeQL rejects mixed versions across its sub-actions, so init, autobuild and analyze update as ONE PR for every update type, majors included (the shared preset groups them only for non-major updates).
